message.content:
London is in the United Kingdom, which uses:

| Season | Time zone name | UTC offset |
|--------|----------------|------------|
| Winter (roughly late October – late March) | Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) | UTC + 0 |
| Summer (roughly late March – late October) | British Summer Time (BST) | UTC + 1 |

So depending on the time of year, London is either on GMT (no offset) or BST (one hour ahead of GMT). If you need the exact current offset right now, let me know and I can fetch the current local time for you.
